chunks: And from him, from Suleyman ibn Salih who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'A man deceives his wife, so he says, 'Make me free from your slave girl, that she may wipe my belly and massage my leg, and from my touching her,' meaning by his touching her is marriage (sleeping with her). He (peace be upon him) said: 'The trickery is in the Fire.' I said, 'If he does not intend trickery by that.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'O Suleyman! I do not see you except that you are deceiving her regarding the mating of her slave girl.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a husband permitting his wife to have sexual relations with her slave girl as a form of 'trickery' or conditional allowance?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) addresses the specific legal nuance of 'temporary permission' (not full marriage) for a slave girl, distinguishing it from permanent marital rights. The Imam’s declaration that 'the deceiver is in the Fire' highlights the ethical gravity of using such arrangements for mere pleasure or convenience rather than genuine contractual intent, while his follow-up remark suggests that even if the primary intent isn't malicious deception, the act itself may still constitute a subtle deprivation of the slave girl's rightful status or dignity (budd'). This reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on the purity of intention and the precise definition of rights in domestic arrangements involving slaves.

en.hubeali: And from him, from Suleyman Bin Salih who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man deceives his wife, so he is saying, ‘Make me to be in freedom from your slave girl, for her to touch my belly, and massage my legs, and from me to touch her’, meaning with touching her with the sleeping with her. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The trickery is in the Fire’. I said, ‘Supposing he does not intend the trickery by that’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Suleyman! I<sup>asws</sup> do not see you except you are tricking her about sleeping with her slave girl’.
